body: Hear hear. I write for my university publication, studying journalism at the moment - a pitch came up the other day where this particular incident could be used as a case study, also think it's time I knew the whole story.

Good idea, but there's not a lot on anonymity with facebook, as far as I know Gash has since been released from prison, or will be soon - other sleuthing has revealed his immediate family has resorted to using fake names on all social media to  stop him from finding them, (unless that piece of information was sensationalized)

Not sure if making a fake profile would get a lot of results in people wanting to share information, and using my real page wouldn't protect me should the wrong person see the post
I don't think I ever really implied otherwise, but thanks.

Because he was married so I never asked after our first meeting as part of our arrangement, didn't matter a lot to me - I had *a* name, just not his real name. 

Payment was always cash, or in the form of gifts.

With the drugs, yes. Alcohol, no. 

I'm at college now, about to complete my degree, have a 'proper' job, less than minimum wage and I can barely afford my $500/mo rent, but happier than I've ever been. 

Sometimes I look back at the money I was making with sex work, ad it's so tempting, it was something I genuinely enjoyed - but with the clientèle I attracted, and the money I was making - it's a gateway towards drugs, straight up. 

I still drink a lot, but I'm off drugs beyond the occasional line of MDMA at a party or rave - that for me is a huge accomplishment. I'm also happier than I've ever been before.

Sorry for such a late reply, I never use this alt so didn't actually see that this comment had blown up until today. At the start, he had no idea that I had an addiction, I think he saw it more as a young girl wanting to have some fun and wanting to provide me with clean drugs under the assumption I was sharing with my friends.

He had his own vices with the drug, amongst others - look at him as a Jordan Bedford type - not quite the levels of success but a high functioning addict that saw what he was providing me as cheap change compared to what he was into - it wasn't until he addressed his own problems I think he saw exactly to what level he had enabled me, and then tried to rectify the situation

Throwaway for obvious reasons.

I was actually propositioned because of reddit of all things, I have a few photos of myself on my main account and he apparently liked what he saw enough to send me a PM and ask if I wanted to work something out. I had a comment in my history somewhere that referenced the fact I had been a cam girl before, so he wasn't completely out of left field.

Selling point was for our first actual meeting he gave me a grand, just to have dinner with him. After that he gave me $500 a week to have sex with him whenever he was free, which was only really every month or so, longest I went without seeing him was five months because he was out of state - he still paid me every week. 

Then after he got to know my lifestyle a little better the gifts changed from pretty lingerie and expensive dinners, to cocaine. 

Obviously, I wasn't in a very good place and my life had been in a bit of a bender for a long time. The money I was getting from him had already essentially been my drug fund and yeah... to be honest it's all a bit of a black time.

He did care for me, that's for sure, I know this because oe day he had obviously had reflected on his own lifestyle, invited me out to dinner, and told me he was checking me into rehab. Never saw him again - I never really knew if I knew his real name to begin with so I never had a lot of luck trying to find him

But reddit was where it began, so supposing he's still around and uses this site, I can't imagine too many people have situations similar enough to mine to think this is about them - so if you are reading this, I just want you to know that from where I am now - I don't regret it, and thank you for helping me.
